title: Turkey's regional rise seems unstoppable after maritime deal with Libya's Hifter
gist: Podcast episode blurb: Libya analyst Jalel Harchaoui explains how Turkey's courting of eastern Libyan strongman Haftar via a maritime deal has cemented Turkish influence in North Africa and beyond. Only a short description is available.

insights.claim: Turkey's courting of Libya's eastern warlord Khalifa Haftar, culminating in a maritime deal, has cemented Turkish influence in North Africa and beyond, according to Libya analyst Jalel Harchaoui.
insights.speaker: Al-Monitor
insights.so_what: Turkish reach in the eastern Mediterranean and North Africa is expanding; relevant to energy and maritime-boundary plays.
